records.key: Cellpose 3 did not return one exact diameter per field. The run cannot be saved reproducibly.
records.source: Cellpose 3 did not return one exact diameter per field. The run cannot be saved reproducibly.
records.translation: Cellpose 3 no devolvió un diámetro exacto por campo. La ejecución no se puede guardar de forma reproducible.

records.key: Completed mask parameters for archive {archive} are missing or differ from the saved run. Use a separate output folder.
records.source: Completed mask parameters for archive {archive} are missing or differ from the saved run. Use a separate output folder.
records.translation: Faltan los parámetros de las máscaras completadas del archivo {archive} o difieren de los de la ejecución guardada. Usa una carpeta de salida independiente.

records.key: Diameter replay requires one field identity per model input and an object role.
records.source: Diameter replay requires one field identity per model input and an object role.
records.translation: Repetir la ejecución con los diámetros guardados requiere un identificador de campo por entrada del modelo y un rol de objeto.

records.key: Normalization field identities must match the image batch.
records.source: Normalization field identities must match the image batch.
records.translation: Los identificadores de campo de la normalización deben corresponder al lote de imágenes.

records.key: Resolved field identities must be nonempty basenames.
records.source: Resolved field identities must be nonempty basenames.
records.translation: Los identificadores de campo determinados deben ser nombres de archivo no vacíos sin la ruta del directorio.

records.key: Resolved mask parameters arrived without an active job.
records.source: Resolved mask parameters arrived without an active job.
records.translation: Se recibieron parámetros de máscara determinados sin una tarea activa.

records.key: Resolved parameter names must be nonempty strings.
records.source: Resolved parameter names must be nonempty strings.
records.translation: Los nombres de los parámetros determinados deben ser cadenas no vacías.

records.key: Resolved parameters must contain finite JSON values.
records.source: Resolved parameters must contain finite JSON values.
records.translation: Los parámetros determinados deben contener valores JSON finitos.

records.key: Resolved source pixels must have a numeric dtype.
records.source: Resolved source pixels must have a numeric dtype.
records.translation: Los píxeles de origen usados para determinar los parámetros deben tener un tipo de datos numérico.

records.key: Saved normalization bounds for field {field} are incomplete or invalid.
records.source: Saved normalization bounds for field {field} are incomplete or invalid.
records.translation: Los límites de normalización guardados para el campo {field} están incompletos o no son válidos.

records.key: Saved normalization for field {field} requires padded shape {saved}; the current batch uses {current}.
records.source: Saved normalization for field {field} requires padded shape {saved}; the current batch uses {current}.
records.translation: La normalización guardada para el campo {field} requiere las dimensiones {saved} tras el relleno; el lote actual usa {current}.

records.key: The resolved diameter must be a finite nonnegative number or None.
records.source: The resolved diameter must be a finite nonnegative number or None.
records.translation: El diámetro determinado debe ser un número finito no negativo o None.

records.key: The resolved-parameter record has an unsupported format. Start with fresh automatic settings.
records.source: The resolved-parameter record has an unsupported format. Start with fresh automatic settings.
records.translation: El registro de parámetros determinados tiene un formato no compatible. Empieza con una nueva configuración automática.

records.key: The saved run has no resolved {parameter} value for field {field}. Use the original field set or start with fresh automatic settings.
records.source: The saved run has no resolved {parameter} value for field {field}. Use the original field set or start with fresh automatic settings.
records.translation: La ejecución guardada no tiene un valor determinado de {parameter} para el campo {field}. Usa el conjunto original de campos o empieza con una nueva configuración automática.

records.key: The source or configuration for {parameter} in field {field} differs from the saved run. Restore the recorded input and settings, or start with fresh automatic settings.
records.source: The source or configuration for {parameter} in field {field} differs from the saved run. Restore the recorded input and settings, or start with fresh automatic settings.
records.translation: El origen o la configuración de {parameter} en el campo {field} difiere de la ejecución guardada. Restaura la entrada y la configuración registradas o empieza con una nueva configuración automática.

records.key: Workers reported different resolved {parameter} values for field {field}. The run cannot be saved reproducibly.
records.source: Workers reported different resolved {parameter} values for field {field}. The run cannot be saved reproducibly.
records.translation: Los procesos de trabajo comunicaron distintos valores determinados para {parameter} en el campo {field}. La ejecución no se puede guardar de forma reproducible.
